# raw/ — pristine agent captures. Do not edit.

These JSON files are the byte-faithful return values of the research agents (find-* = findings, verify-* = adversarial verdict, compact-* = findings minus table bodies). They are provenance for the `.md` files one level up, and they deliberately still contain claims that were later refuted — the corrections live in the `.md` files and in `open-questions.md`, never here. If a raw file disagrees with a research file, the research file wins.
